segments.ja418:1.5: Tyajja bhekena [bhiṅgena (ka.)] yāpema, okaṃ na vajahāmase [okantaṃ na jahāmase (ka.)].
segments.ja418:2.1: Ko dutiyaṃ asīlissa, bandharassakkhi bhecchati [bhejjati (sī. syā. pī.), bhindati (ka.)];
segments.ja418:2.3: Ko me putte kulāvakaṃ, mañca sotthiṃ karissati.
segments.ja418:3.1: Sabbā parikkhayā pheggu, yāva tassā gatī ahu;
segments.ja418:3.3: Khīṇabhakkho mahārāja, sāre na ramatī ghuṇo.
segments.ja418:4.1: Sā nūnāhaṃ ito gantvā, rañño muttā nivesanā;
segments.ja418:5.1: So nūnāhaṃ ito gantvā, rañño mutto nivesanā;
segments.ja418:6.1: Taṃ maṃ kāmehi sammattaṃ, rattaṃ kāmesu mucchitaṃ;
segments.ja418:6.3: Ānayī bharato [vanato (ka.)] luddo, bāhiko bhaddamatthu te.
segments.ja418:7.3: Sā maṃ saṇhena mudunā, mā pādaṃ khali [khaṇi (sī. syā. pī.)] yasmani.
segments.ja418:8.3: Ayamantimā pacchimā gabbhaseyyā [ayaṃ hi me antimā gabbhaseyyā (sī. pī.)], khīṇo me saṃsāro punabbhavāyāti.
